content.headline: Build your own enterprise prompt
content.body: Fill in five fields — Role, Context, Task, Constraints, Format — then click Assemble, Copy, and open it in ChatGPT or Claude.
bullets: Try scenarios: land records, load shedding, disaster relief, citizen charter
Keep constraints tight — set word count, tone, and ban invented facts
Remember: AI drafts it, but the officer is still the signing authority
